- [Do not say](rules/do-not-say.md): forbidden claims and safe replacements.
- [Feature status](rules/feature-status.md): shipped versus in build versus roadmap.
- [Glossary](rules/glossary.md): canonical vocabulary.

## Operations and state
- [Copy bank](ops/copy-bank.md): approved language, safe to reuse verbatim.
- [Decision log](ops/decisions.md): what was decided, when, and why.
- [Signal log](ops/signal-log.md): raw market input and its disposition.
- [Asset index](ops/asset-index.md): where sources and live surfaces live.
- [QA checklist](ops/QA-checklist.md): the pre-ship gate.
- [Review cadence](ops/review-cadence.md): who reviews what, how often.

## Portability (doors for other tools)
- [Adapters](adapters/): one pointer file per tool in use, each naming the same load order.
- [Portable control layer](adapters/portable-control-layer.md): dated paste-in version for chat models with no file access. Regenerate whenever a ledger changes.

## Snapshots
- `snapshots/`: dated captures of funnel, channel, segment, and competitive state, each ending in what it changed.
